# Constants
SMTP_SERVER = "smtp.gmail.com"
SMTP_PORT = 587
EMAIL_ADDRESS = "your.email@gmail.com"
EMAIL_PASSWORD = "your.password"
def task_func(input_data=None, smtp_server=SMTP_SERVER, smtp_port=SMTP_PORT, email_address=EMAIL_ADDRESS, email_password=EMAIL_PASSWORD, smtp=None):
    if input_data is None:
        return []
    try:
        data = json.loads(input_data)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return []

    recipients = []
    names = []

    if isinstance(data, dict):
        data = [data]
    if isinstance(data, list):
        for item in data:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue
            email = item.get("email") or item.get("recipient") or item.get("address")
            name = item.get("name")
            if email and name:
                recipients.append(email)
                names.append(name)
    else:
        return []

    if not recipients or not names:
        return []

    message_lines = ["Subject: Extracted Names", ""]
    message_lines.extend(names)
    message = "\n".join(message_lines)

    close_smtp = False
    if smtp is None:
        smtp = smtplib.SMTP(smtp_server, smtp_port)
        close_smtp = True
        smtp.starttls()
        smtp.login(email_address, email_password)

    smtp.sendmail(email_address, recipients, message)

    if close_smtp:
        smtp.quit()

    return names
